coordinatorSummary: CONSENT at zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX. Subject custody holds at 189584aa… / mode 0444. All eleven pinned digests recompute exactly, including occupancy v5 and occupancy v2, which resolve by content hash to harness.DR-G16.ci-isolation-integration.v5.json and .v2.json. Stage A is genuinely dual independent ACCEPT 0/0. The draft names MLJ4-O1, MLJ4-O2 and MLJ4-O3, correctly types them as objects, correctly describes Codex's empty observationsNotFindings, empty observations and zero advisories, invents no identifier on either side, and explicitly declines to claim that both reviewers' identifiers are preserved. Live state reads off file 08 as drafted: DR-121 OPEN, DR-G16 OPEN, DR-107 PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW, DR-118 DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED, DR-119 SATISFIED and untouched, required-now 28 (32 gate rows less DR-G05/G17/G26/G30), owners 32 of 32, last gate row DR-G32. leftover-join.v3 is recorded as current at draft time and non-current only after this successor lands; occupancy v2 is never recorded as current; g16 leftover-join.v4 stays current on its separate lineage. leftoverDesign measures from the artifact as exactly OBL-G16-FX-AUTHORING and OBL-CI-ENCODING-RESERVED, and neither is stolen as a GATE closure. The no-cell-edit branch enumerates without gaps across D-170 through D-235, D-237 through D-271 and D-273 through D-276, does not span D-236, and excludes CONTESTED D-272. The strongest available attack — that the draft omits the historical-predecessor row and landed-repair disposition its D-276 template carried — fails because the monorepo lineage inherited no outstanding repair. Nothing was found to fix.
